construct: Placental steroid sulfatase converts sulfated steroid precursors such as DHEAS to unconjugated forms used in placental estrogen synthesis. STS deficiency reduces maternal unconjugated estriol during pregnancy and causes X-linked ichthyosis in affected male offspring; delayed or abnormal labor can occur.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A male fetus, profoundly low maternal unconjugated estriol, and maternal-line males with X-linked ichthyosis identify placental steroid sulfatase deficiency.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Aromatase deficiency also reduces placental estrogen synthesis, but it causes androgen accumulation with maternal/fetal virilization rather than an X-linked ichthyosis pedigree.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The X-linked pedigree plus low uE3 specifically points to STS deficiency.
